ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Your Materialious username (3-18 chars). Sign-ups stay open only until this account registers, and it gets the admin panel.

COOKIE_SECRET.description: Signs login cookies. Changing it signs everyone out.

DATABASE_CONNECTION_URI.description: Accounts, subscriptions and history live in SQLite on the volume.

PUBLIC_DEFAULT_INVIDIOUS_INSTANCE.description: Your own Invidious, used for all video data.

ORIGIN.description: Public URL of Materialious. Change it when you add a custom domain.

deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -c "until nc -z $PGHOST 5432; do echo waiting for postgres; sleep 2; done; exec /invidious/invidious"

PORT.description: Port Invidious listens on (also referenced from INVIDIOUS_CONFIG).

HMAC_KEY.description: Auto-generated HMAC secret used to sign user session cookies. Do NOT change after first deploy — all signed-in sessions will be invalidated.

INVIDIOUS_CONFIG.description: Full Invidious config in YAML. Database credentials, companion wiring, and domain are all references — leave them alone.

INVIDIOUS_COMPANION_KEY.description: Auto-generated shared secret authenticating the Invidious↔Companion link. Companion.SERVER_SECRET_KEY references this value.

PGHOST.description: Postgres host the start command waits for before launching. Don't change.

PORT.description: Port Companion listens on (referenced from Invidious config)

SERVER_SECRET_KEY.description: Shared secret with Invidious. Must reference Invidious's variable, NOT be independently generated.

PGDATA.description: Subdirectory inside the volume mount. Postgres won't initialize in a directory that already contains lost+found, so we use a child path.

PGHOST.description: Internal hostname inside Railway's private IPv6 network. Auto-resolved at deploy time.

PGUSER.description: Reference to POSTGRES_USER, for libpq-based clients (psql, pg_dump) that read PGUSER instead of POSTGRES_USER.

PGDATABASE.description: Reference to POSTGRES_DB, for libpq clients.

PGPASSWORD.description: Reference to POSTGRES_PASSWORD, for libpq clients.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created on first boot. Static.

DATABASE_URL.description: Full Postgres connection string for clients that expect a single URL. Composed from references — auto-updates if the password is regenerated.

POSTGRES_USER.description: Postgres superuser name. Static; matches the upstream Postgres image's default convention.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Auto-generated Postgres password. Sealed at deploy time. Referenced by PGPASSWORD and DATABASE_URL — do not change after first deploy or existing connections will break.
